title: Kaplansky's Idempotent Conjecture
exact_target: Are zero and one the only idempotents in the ordinary group ring of every torsion-free group over every field?

sources.citation: Johan Öinert, Units, Zero-divisors and Idempotents in Rings Graded by Torsion-Free Groups (arXiv:1904.04847v3), Problem 1(c); Gardam (2021), introduction.
